extraction.Name: Jesse Peters
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to R. C. Spinning for $1700 then sold for $2000 allottee receiving but $65.00 for the land.
extraction.Buyer: Land sold for $2000 which the allottee thinks was $1000 below market value.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It seems that the mortgage prevented him from receiving more money for the land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Bad eyesight. No property and no money accumulated. Wife and two children dependent upon him. Date and manner of delivery of patent: Jan. 1918, Agency Office. It is believed that the allottee did not receive full value for his land. Notarized November 26, 1928; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
